description: Pinned identities for the Burnout Xbox recompilation. tools/verify-inputs.sh checks the live files against this file; nothing in the pipeline may run against unverified inputs.

source_media.access: read-only; never copied into version control

xboxrecomp.note: Seeding requires commit c70542c or newer. Pinned to d2a9934 on main (2026-10-14): 7602903 + daa4900 frame pointer for frameless (fpo_leaf) functions and SEH callers, d2a9934 fxam; fixes the race-start crash and then the invisible racing cars on HeroGame (HeroLab e2c5e948, upstream ledger fd715465). Before that f52f6c3 on main (2026-10-13): burnout/async-perf merged (4e90527 KeTickCount thread + movable kernel VAs, aac6317 downmix, a8ee8fd vertex fast path, be42873 async PFIFO, 7b5fde6 GPU/APU ISR wakes, 1f86f07 texture cache, 90381c0 bulk decode, 74abb07 indexed draws, 25aa446 clear-value mirror, 16b002f XBOXRECOMP_GUEST_KEVENTS per-title switch, on for Burnout in CMakeLists) and burnout/res-scale (3ace187 XBOXRECOMP_RES_SCALE, f52f6c3 discrete-GPU exports). HeroLab 7b9e050b. Before that 19a645b (logical flags), 2aa8c96 (fixed-function pipeline), 4b362fc (0cc57b6 2D mapping, swizzled 0x06/0x19). Earlier: c6cad72 (2026-10-07) rebaselined on 18a20e2 (HeroLab f31e831d). AllowedMediaTypes is relaxed at load since 42c4b8c (XBOXRECOMP_MEDIA_PATCH=0 restores the retail disc check). See HeroLab tasks 875a0ee7 and df74a7c7.
